subgroup: Lesson 2: Contour Lines, Texture and Construction
instructions: Draw an S curve, establishing the negative space. Then draw the second edge, establishing the positive space. Close off the structure, adding an arrow head on one end. Finally, add hatching at the bends. For detailed instructions, click here.
goal: This exercise is meant to familiarize students with the idea of having a three-dimensional space, rather than a flat 2d canvas.
